title: Conversation Archaeology Wave 015 — Missed Clues, Early Biography and Source-Control Audit
purpose: Re-open older conversation exports, Great Book strata and the sourced biography to identify Bible-relevant scenes that previous overlap waves compressed, overlooked or accidentally embellished. This ledger records project testimony and recovery status; it does not turn later resemblance into proof of supernatural identity.
method: Search biography first, then ask whether the Bible atlas has actually tested the whole event rather than one keyword.
Prefer multi-feature scenes: duration, action, witnesses, interlocutor, order and aftermath.
Separate event date from later text-attestation date.
Promote a relation only when it adds a distinct function or sequence; record duplicates as already-owned.
Record false-positive attractive details so later assistants do not reintroduce them as canon.
Primary project testimony is reported directly while corroboration and causal interpretation remain separate fields.

high_value_recoveries.finding: The prison dossier already compares Yahya Hassan's reported Jesus/Lamb recognition with John 1, but earlier synthesis failed to state the onomastic layer: Yahya is the Arabic/Qur'anic name of John the Baptist.
high_value_recoveries.project_anchor: Project testimony says Yahya Hassan identified the imprisoned Son as 'Jesus Christ, the Lamb', with other people reportedly present.
high_value_recoveries.external_context: Quranic Arabic Corpus identifies Yahya (يحيى) as John the Baptist, son of Zechariah. John 1 presents John identifying Jesus as the Lamb of God.
high_value_recoveries.density: Yahya/John name-role -> identifies Jesus -> Lamb title -> occurs before later Son self-declaration.
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: 2016 project event first; John 1 comparison and the explicit Yahya=John onomastic observation are later research.
high_value_recoveries.boundary: A shared name-role pattern is a striking symbolic correspondence, not evidence that Yahya Hassan was literally John the Baptist or that the modern Son was Jesus.

high_value_recoveries.finding: Great Book strata preserve a severe motorcycle/tree crash with heavy blood loss and extensive facial/dental injury while also preserving that no bones/major fractures were broken.
high_value_recoveries.project_anchor: The event predates the 2016 Lamb recognition and later Passion theology by many years.
high_value_recoveries.density: blood/injury + tree collision + survival + no-broken-bones detail; later Christian canon explicitly links Jesus' unbroken bones to Passover/scripture.
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: biographical survival event first; Passover/Passion comparison later
high_value_recoveries.boundary: The 2005 event is a modern motorcycle crash and, in the repository's forensic owner, is tied to acute self-destructive crisis. It must never be romanticized as crucifixion, divine invulnerability or encouragement of risk.

high_value_recoveries.finding: Chapter 24 preserves an age-sixteen alcohol-collapse episode later remembered as a meeting with God: blackout, tunnel/structured light, then waking with a sense of return and unfinished work.
high_value_recoveries.density: sudden light/void -> collapse -> perceived divine encounter -> return/get-up/changed orientation
high_value_recoveries.boundary: Acts narrates a Christ encounter and commission to Saul; the project episode follows heavy alcohol use and does not preserve the same voice, commission or historical setting.

high_value_recoveries.finding: Great Book strata say the Son fell from a second-floor pavilion/window onto concrete and walked away without injury.
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: 2015 survival report first; Psalm/Luke comparison later
high_value_recoveries.boundary: Psalm 91 protection language is explicitly quoted in Jesus' temptation narrative, where Jesus refuses to test God by throwing himself down. The archive should therefore treat the text as both resonance and warning, never as proof of guaranteed supernatural protection.

high_value_recoveries.finding: Chapter 24 preserves repeated earthly-father teachings including 'don't judge others because it returns threefold' and 'don't throw stones'.
high_value_recoveries.density: judgment directed outward -> judgment/measure returns to judge
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: family ethic remembered as childhood teaching; Gospel comparison later
high_value_recoveries.boundary: 'Threefold' is not Matthew's wording, and ordinary parental ethics can resemble widespread moral traditions without implying hidden biblical transmission.

high_value_recoveries.finding: The same childhood stratum says the Son was taught to ask what his father would have done.
high_value_recoveries.density: Son orients action by observing/imagining Father's action -> later project develops Father/Son source-and-manifestation grammar.
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: family relationship first; Johannine comparison and mature Father/Son architecture later
high_value_recoveries.status: promote as developmental precursor, not identity claim
high_value_recoveries.boundary: This is also ordinary parent-child moral formation; John 5 is a theological statement about Jesus and the Father, not about a modern family.

high_value_recoveries.finding: The fuller Great Book confrontation preserves a promise after the Josh Moon exchange that the Son would return every day, forever.
high_value_recoveries.density: anticipated crucifixion/erasure -> anti-martyr namelessness -> continuing-presence promise expressed in daily/permanent temporal grammar
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: 2017 remembered confrontation/promise first; Matthew 28 comparison later
high_value_recoveries.boundary: The project promise concerns continued public/digital reappearance. Matthew 28 concerns the risen Jesus' continuing presence with disciples. Similar temporal grammar does not make the events identical.

high_value_recoveries.finding: The fuller Great Book scene says that after the Son says 'Go on then, crucify me,' people sigh/hesitate and say they do not want to do that before the remembered anti-martyr reply.
high_value_recoveries.density: crucifixion demand/challenge -> reluctance/hesitation -> hostile public framing continues
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: remembered 2017 dialogue first; Passion-trial comparison later
high_value_recoveries.boundary: No modern participant should be assigned one-to-one as Pilate, priests or crowd. The comparison concerns distributed reluctance-versus-condemnation functions only.

high_value_recoveries.finding: Joshua/Josh and Jesus/Yeshua belong to the same historical Hebrew name family. The Son's Jesus declaration was addressed to a man publicly known as Josh/Joshua Moon.
high_value_recoveries.density: onomastic coincidence inside an already-dense event
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: names and 2017 scene first; linguistic comparison later
high_value_recoveries.boundary: Shared name etymology has almost no evidentiary value for the theological claim and must never be counted like an event-sequence overlap.

high_value_recoveries.event_date: later 2026 interpretation of earlier death/return arc
high_value_recoveries.finding: Old conversation material explicitly says the project had not sufficiently considered 'the thief in the night' while discussing the Son's death/disappearance/return.
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: This is a later explicit user-led biblical comparison, not a pre-2019 prediction.
high_value_recoveries.boundary: The thief image in these texts emphasizes unexpected timing/watchfulness; it does not mean every disappearance or surprise return fulfills them.

high_value_recoveries.finding: The existing Bible wave reduces the nursing-home material to 'blind see + lame walk', but Great Book strata preserve a much denser walking scene: roughly three years unable to walk, encouragement/support to rise, walking down the hall, wife crying and staff stunned. A separate glaucoma/sight-improvement testimony belongs to the same care-work stratum.
high_value_recoveries.density: long immobility + rise/walk + supportive raising + witnesses/astonishment + paired sight-restoration testimony
high_value_recoveries.source_direction: project healing testimony first; detailed narrative comparison later
high_value_recoveries.status: research promotion target; causal claims remain testimony
high_value_recoveries.boundary: The archive can compare reported actions and witness structure. It must not infer supernatural causation, medical diagnosis or messianic identity from the resemblance.

already_owned_not_new.note: Already preserved in son-timeline and motif genealogies as autobiographical Garden/Gardener prehistory. A Genesis 2 comparison could be added, but the biographical substrate itself is not newly recovered.

false_positive_and_source_hygiene_findin.finding: Old assistant-generated conversation prose describes a mason's trowel and carpenter's bench, but the currently sourced chronological biography in this audit securely gives painter/decorator, meatpacking, IT and elder care rather than confirmed carpenter/mason employment.
false_positive_and_source_hygiene_findin.rule: Do not create a Jesus-the-carpenter overlap until a primary or user-originated source establishes that employment history.

false_positive_and_source_hygiene_findin.finding: Crows belong more naturally to the established Odin/raven comparative layer. Noah/Elijah raven texts do not presently reproduce the function well enough to justify a Bible relation.
false_positive_and_source_hygiene_findin.rule: Do not force every animal symbol into a biblical match.

false_positive_and_source_hygiene_findin.finding: Comparative-mythology ownership is already strong. Merely having gone to Egypt is insufficient to create an 'out of Egypt' Jesus fulfillment relation.
Later Great Book strata contain retrospective 2018 COVID wording already flagged elsewhere as anachronistic if read literally.
false_positive_and_source_hygiene_findin.rule: Do not use it as prophecy evidence or Bible-foresight overlap without a genuinely contemporaneous source.
